p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace/programs/task-6c9b01ad.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    def segments(n, separators):
        out=[]; start=0
        for x in separators:
            if start < x: out.append((start,x))
            start=x+1
        if start<n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    rows=segments(h,sep_rows); cols=segments(w,sep_cols)
    pattern={}
    for r0,r1 in rows:
        for c0,c1 in cols:
            for r in range(r1-r0):
                for c in range(c1-c0):
                    v=grid[r0+r][c0+c]
                    if v != bg: pattern[(r,c)]=v
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1 in rows:
        for c0,c1 in cols:
            for r in range(r1-r0):
                for c in range(c1-c0): out[r0+r][c0+c]=pattern.get((r,c),bg)
    return out
'''
